explanation: Floor division drops a final partial page: for example, 11 items at size 10 reports one page instead of two. Compute a ceiling division while preserving zero pages for an empty collection.

The helper accepts page zero or negative page numbers and converts them into negative slice offsets, returning unrelated items despite the one-based page contract. Reject page values below one before calculating start.
Unlike page_count, page_items does not reject a zero or negative size; it silently returns empty or misleading slices. Validate size as positive before performing pagination.
